title: Ledup projects reel
description: A white panel with 50px corners holding a swipeable, draggable row of 4:3 project photos. On desktop the label, headline and paragraph sit low at the left beside a slowly spinning ring of text with an arrow (a drag hint), and the reel runs at the right with the next photo peeking; on phones the headline sits on top, the photos peek from the right edge and a short progress bar follows the scroll. The text and reel rise 24px into view.
notes: the panel is bg-card on a bg-background page (white on near-white, as the original)
project media fill each 4:3 frame (cover); empty shows a muted placeholder
touch and trackpads scroll natively; a mouse can drag the reel (needs JavaScript: hydrate visible). The progress bar is a CSS scroll timeline
